{{Quote|We've got ourselves a ''Hutt problem''. Two ''low-lifes'' called ''Bo-Dum'' and ''Rarsk'' acting like they ''own'' the planet. We need ''help'' to get rid of them. ''Professional'' help.|[[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TCK" />}}
'''Bo-Dum''' was a member of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and a minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. With his fellow Hutt [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]], Bo-Dum imposed his rule on a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for a time. Ultimately, the two Hutts were [[Skirmish on unidentified planet (Jenna)|defeated]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the famous [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and his [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|If we ''don't'' make some real money ''soon'', we'll ''never'' buy our way ''back'' into the ''Cartel''.|[[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]], to Bo-Dum|<ref name="TCK" />}}
[[File:Huttese_fish_beer.png|thumb|left|250px|Bo-Dum (left) and Rarsk were once members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].]]
Bo-Dum was part of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="TCK" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of rotund [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropods]] that were reputed for dabbling in shady business throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|hutt|Hutt}}</ref> He and his partner [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]] were once part of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]],<ref name="TCK" /> a crime syndicate and an alliance between several Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]],<ref name="Cartel">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutt Cartel}}</ref> but the two were evicted from the organization. Unable to buy their way back into the Cartel, the two low-life Hutts came to impose their law to a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that had a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian settlement|settlement]]. They notably had some of their thugs [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] of the settlement so that the colonists found themselves without a lawman to protect them. Additionally, Bo-Dum took a fancy to [[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]], the [[Jenna's father|late sheriff's]] daughter. The Hutt's interest in the young woman, however, was far from reciprocated.<ref name="TCK" />

===Meeting the Corellian Kid===
{{Quote|You won't get away with this, Solo. I'll put a ''price'' on your head so high, even the ''Mighty Jabba'' will turn ''bounty hunter''!|Bo-Dum, to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TCK" />}}
At some point, the famous Corellian smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] crashed on the planet aboard their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. A trio of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|drones]] owned by the Hutts managed to shoot the ''Falcon'' down, although its crew survived. Unbeknownst to Bo-Dum and his partner, Jenna convinced Solo to help the settlers to get rid of the Hutts. Meanwhile, Bo-Dum and Rarsk learned that the ship their drones had shot earlier was salvageable, but were not informed of its owner's identity.<ref name="TCK" />

[[File:Bo-Dum_and_Rask.png|thumb|250px|Rarsk and Bo-Dum (right) emerge from their [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].]]
Upon arriving to the Corellian settlement, Bo-Dum discovered that Jenna was waiting for him. He attempted to molest her, but was interrupted by the growl of Chewbacca, whom Jenna described as the new sheriff. As Bo-Dum did not wish to confront a Wookiee, he retreated to the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] with Rarsk so they could make new plans. While the Hutts were discussing, a masked individual who called himself "the Corellian Kid" informed them that the crashed ship was that of Han Solo. Knowing that one of their fellow Hutts, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], had put a [[Bounty/Legends|price]] on Solo's head, Bo-Dum and Rarsk decided to hire the Corellian Kid, promising that he would get forty percent of the bounty after salvaging the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} wreck. The next day by dawn, Bo-Dum, Rarsk and the Corellian Kid embarked for the crash site on board of a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Once they arrived, it became obvious that the whole bargain was a trap. Not only were the Corellian settlers waiting for them in arms, but the ''Falcon'' had been repaired to its full working order. The so-called Corellian Kid, who was none other than Solo in disguise, left the Hutts alone in their vehicle a split second before the settlers [[Skirmish on unidentified planet (Jenna)|attacked]]. Emerging from his now battered [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], Bo-Dum witnessed the ''Millennium Falcon'' taking off, taking Solo, Chewbacca and the Corellian settlers with it.<ref name="TCK" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Bo-Dum.png|thumb|left|250px|Bo-Dum was a green-skinned Hutt who bore [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].]]
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Jenna''. You become more ''incandescent'' every time we meet. I was so ''sorry'' to hear about your father.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Sorry''? It was one of ''your'' thugs that ''killed'' him.|Bo-Dum and [[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]]|<ref name="TCK" />}}
A male Hutt, Bo-Dum was known to have had a lust for at least one female [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="TCK" /> a preoccupation that most other Hutts regarded as both perverse and inexplicable.<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> As with all Hutts, Bo-Dum was large and plump. He had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.<ref name="TCK" /> While the Hutts were not defenseless, with their tails that could be used as weapons to bludgeon their enemies to death,<ref name="JH:TDT">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Dynasty Trap]]''</ref> Bo-Dum was too cowardly to engage in a fight against Chewbacca. On at least one occasion, Bo-Dum made use of hypocritical humor, noting how "sorry" he was upon "hearing" of the demise of Jenna's father.<ref name="TCK" />

==Equipment==
Bo-Dum wore a purple [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on the right shoulder and a chunky bracelet on the wrist of the corresponding arm. He also sported various [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on the belly, tail, [[Breast/Legends|chest]] area and around the eyes.<ref name="TCK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bo-Dum first appeared in ''[[The Corellian Kid]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Christopher Cooper]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]], which was published in [[2014]] in [[Star Wars Comic 7.11|''Star Wars Comic'' 7.11]].
